g.text: Flash vs Pro · full-flat and progressive

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Scaffold test · Flash: 3 runs, mean ± SD · Pro: 1 run, no SD · default 4/2 card budget
All curves use the same test cohort, cumulative evidence and tools. None and query priors are model-specific.
Dashed/open: full-flat; solid/filled: progressive. Right-side baselines are unchanged; KNN references are train-only.
Whiskers show ±1 sample SD across repeated runs (not a confidence interval). Single-run curves have no estimated uncertainty interval.
